scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix desktop"
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run dist --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:portable: npm run build --prefix client && npm run dist:portable --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build --prefix client && npm run pack --prefix desktop
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix desktop
